attack_steps: An untrusted contributor supplies an unsupported binary in the indexed scope.
Indexing archives it but creates no task or durable per-path unsupported disposition.
The immediate response reports only a skipped count and the retained event omits the path.
Later status and search omit the gap and can report full enrichment with no pending work.
assumptions: The operator indexes the supplied scope.
Status or search completeness is later trusted after the immediate index response is unavailable.
attack_path_facts.context: Durable completeness and recovery telemetry omit archived-but-unsearchable input.
attack_path_facts.exposure: An ordinary untrusted direct-child file is processed by the local CLI; no network exposure is required.
attack_path_facts.identity: A lower-trust content contributor influences trusted operator or automation completeness decisions.
preconditions: Later reliance on status or search telemetry.
attack_path_facts.attacker_control: A content contributor controls the file bytes and format needed to deterministically reach the unsupported branch.
mitigations: The immediate invocation reports the skipped-file count.
attack_path_facts.auth_scope: internal-only: no authorization bypass occurs, but untrusted scope content crosses into trusted completeness decisions.
attack_path_facts.impact_surface: data: search completeness, recovery decisions, and automation consuming enrichment status
attack_path_facts.target_reach: Any unsupported file in the supplied scope; aggregate scope completeness can be false.
counterevidence: No confidentiality, network-consent, or budget boundary is bypassed.
The immediate count reveals that some input was skipped.
controls: A one-run skipped counter and INFO event expose the gap class.
Task-based status aggregation is the broken completeness control.
attack_path_facts.rationale: The lower-trust path is direct and deterministic: an ordinary unsupported file produces durable false completeness and non-actionable status. Impact is bounded to search and workflow integrity. Medium impact plus high likelihood maps mechanically to medium.

counterevidence: No confidentiality, network-consent, or budget boundary is bypassed.
The immediate count reveals that some input was skipped.
remediation_subsumption_decision: Persist a path-bearing unsupported disposition; legacy task migration remains separate.
